### New in 1.7.8
- **Posts.** Like and share counts are gone. A post can include up to 3 books. Tap a book on someone’s post and it pops up with the title, author and description. The book file stays on their phone.
- **To-do reminders.** A to-do with no date, or a date and no time, stays quiet. Set both a date and a time and Shelfwise shows a popup and sends a phone notification about an hour before, and again at the time. Turn on To-do reminders in Settings.
- **Shelf order.** In the Library, tap Arrange (or Move up / Move down on a shelf) to change the order. Home uses that same order.

### Updating from 1.7.3 or older (one time only)
Shelfwise 1.7.4 and later use a new signing key, so Android may say **"App not installed as package conflicts with an existing package"**. If it does:
1. In Shelfwise, open **Settings → Backup & restore**. Turn on **Include book files** to keep your PDFs and EPUBs, then tap **Share backup** and save the file somewhere safe (Drive, Files…).
2. Uninstall Shelfwise, then install `shelfwise.apk` from below.
3. Open **Settings → Backup & restore → Import backup**.

If you already installed 1.7.4 or newer, this update installs over the top and keeps your data.

### Install / update
Download `shelfwise.apk` below and open it.
